methodology: Independent Spanish review of the final 50 entries, compared field by field against the initial candidate snapshot. All definitions, examples, forms, register, source coverage and provisional placement reassessed; unchanged learner fields retain their initial review. Final replacements were independently checked against DLE. Selected production concepts and related senses were inspected, including eludir, cuestionar, evaluar, delimitar, orgullo, honor, dignidad, paradoja, duda and reserva. The check did not find a remaining duplicate selected production sense; it is not an exhaustive proof that no remote synonym exists.
placementAssessment: These are provisional contextual C2 practice selections, not exclusive C2 words or official CEFR assignments. Idioms and formal expressions may be acquired earlier. A1-C1 concepts can be prerequisites: a new idiomatic form, register-specific precision or pragmatic use must be documented rather than merely asserted harder. Bare susceptibility was replaced; contextual ordinary expressions remain practice selections rather than a certified level inventory.
evidenceCorrections: The initial review attached candidate URLs to three observations made at alternate DLE headwords. Correct observations were at /rizo (rizar el rizo), /fuer (a fuer de), and /cosa (como quien no quiere la cosa), not /rizar, /fuero, /querer. The final dataset and review use the actually observed headwords; historical r1 is preserved. BOE vicio oculto PDF and replacement pundonor/anfibología/beneficio pages were independently opened for final review.
